unit_normalization.assumption: For these three stations only, particulate *_ppm values are interpreted as mg/m3 logger mass concentrations and multiplied by 1000 to ug/m3. Gas *_ppm values are assumed ppmv and converted at 25 C and 1 atm using molecular mass / 24.45 * 1000. These are user-approved analytical assumptions, not committee-confirmed logger settings.

gas_reference.assumption: Fixed reference conditions; do not substitute weather temperature or infer unrecorded ambient pressure.
